heroSummary: Gilbert Public Schools begins the 2026–27 school year on Tuesday, July 28, 2026. The last day for students is Thursday, May 27, 2027, and it is a K–12 half day. The calendar also includes frequent one-hour early releases, K–6 conference half days, and two end-of-semester half days with different grade-level schedules.
calendarNotes: GPS uses several short-day labels. One-hour early releases appear throughout the year, K–12 half days are listed separately, and K–6 conference half days apply to elementary grades.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Gilbert Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Gilbert Public Schools starts the 2026–27 school year on Tuesday, July 28, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: What does early release mean on the GPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The GPS family calendar marks many dates as one-hour early releases. Exact dismissal times can vary by school, so families should confirm bell schedules with their campus.

calendarFaqs.q: Are all GPS half days the same?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Some dates are K–12 half days, the September conference dates are K–6 half days, and the December 17 end-of-semester half day applies only to grades 7–12.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Gilbert Public Schools spring break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring break runs from Monday, March 15, through Friday, March 26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded Gilbert calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. It is a one-time import, so later GPS changes will not appear automatically.

customSections.label: How Gilbert Public Schools’ Calendar Works
customSections.content: GPS uses several types of shortened school days, and each follows a different schedule. A one-hour early release is different from a K–12 half day, a K–6 conference half day, or an end-of-semester half day with grade-specific attendance. Check your school’s bell schedule for exact dismissal times.

rows: Usually scheduled on Wednesdays; students leave one hour earlier than normal.
These apply to all grade levels and include grading days and the final day of school.
September 17–18 are half days for K–6 students because of parent-teacher conferences.
December 17 is an end-of-semester half day for grades 7–12; December 18 is an end-of-semester half day for K–12 students.
The school year has 180 student days: 89 in the first semester and 91 in the second.
The calendar lists summer school from June 7 through July 2, 2027. GPS publishes registration and program details separately.
